composition_subtypes.role: Outer binary search to minimize total cost
Inner exhaustive enumeration over ATK/DEF purchases with early exit

payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search over total cost with inner exhaustive enumeration of ATK/DEF purchases to check feasibility.
payload.rationale: Solution uses binary search on answer (sorting family) to minimize cost, and inside the feasibility check, it enumerates all possible ATK and DEF within budget (complete search). This is a classic composition of binary search and exhaustive check.
